purpose.zh: 拉伸前腿的臀部和后腿的髋前侧
purpose.en: Stretch the glute of your front leg and the front of your back hip.

text.zh: 上身挺直，呼气时微微往前倾
text.en: Stay tall and lean forward slightly as you breathe out

text.zh: 前腿小腿横在身前，后腿往后伸直，双手扶砖。
text.en: Front shin across your body, back leg straight behind you, hands on the blocks.

text.zh: 骨盆尽量摆正，别硬往下压。
text.en: Keep your hips as square as you can and do not force them down.

commonErrors.en: Letting your hips tilt to one side.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼时垫高臀部，或换成仰卧4字拉伸
cautions.en: If your knee hurts, prop your hips higher or switch to the lying figure-4 stretch.

changes: 剂量 → 每侧 2 组×4 次（rep_hold，stretchLoop）
EN 名 Pigeon Pose → Pigeon Stretch（与其余拉伸统一）
primary 缩短为一个指令（扶砖移到 cue2）
flags: 拉伸按次数：原剂量是静止计时，但动画每 8 秒做一次「进入-停住约 3.6 s-回来」，按规则改成按次数（rep_hold，training.stretchLoop=true）；想改回计时需动画改成一直停住，请定
